en: What if phones had never been invented?
This morning I suddenly wondered about it… and I couldn't stop thinking!
The telephone was invented in 1876. Before that, talking to someone far away wasn't easy at all!
say: The telephone was invented in eighteen seventy-six. Before that, talking to someone far away wasn't easy at all!

en: I want to talk to Grandma, who lives far away. With no phone, I'd have to write her a letter.
The letter rides in the mail truck and takes days to arrive. When Grandma writes back, I wait days again!
Our family goes on a trip and gets lost! No map app, so Dad has to unfold a giant paper map.
Want to play with my best friend? I'd run to his house and knock: "Is Xiaoming home? Can he come out to play?"
say: Want to play with my best friend? I'd run to his house and knock. Is Xiao Ming home? Can he come out to play?

en: If someone gets hurt or there's a fire, nobody can call for help. Someone has to run as fast as they can to get a doctor or firefighters!
Maybe everyone would send notes by pigeon! People long ago really trained homing pigeons to fly messages home.
On the bus there are no phone games. I'd read a book, watch the clouds out the window, or chat with the person next to me.
Without phones, lots of things would be slower and harder. But at dinner, maybe everyone would look at each other and talk more.
What do you think? Would you want to live in a world without phones? Why?
